escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, late morning): a corner of the Efeonce open-plan office next to the team desks, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at a warm-white matte plaster wall 3 m away; horizon level, verticals straight. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of the lettering on that wall — «Crecimiento orgánico» with its azure sphere as the period — reproduce it exactly as cut matte navy vinyl letters applied flat on the plaster, mounted high; directly below it, on the floor, a large matte white ceramic planter with a lush, real, healthy rubber plant whose top leaves reach just under the lettering. LEFT THIRD: a floating oak shelf at head height holding a small brushed-steel trophy cup with no engraving and the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid DEEP NAVY (#023C70, dark ink blue, never royal blue) desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on the shelf beside the trophy, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), satin finish, crisp bevel. At the far left edge, a sliver of a team desk with a current-generation borderless monitor, its blue screen glow out of focus. LIGHT: hard low sun from the LEFT through tall windows out of frame crosses the space as crisp visible shafts and throws a sharp, graphic shadow of the plant's leaves across the wall beside the lettering; the centre of the wall stays calm and evenly lit, no beam there. TRACES OF WORK: a desk chair pushed back at an angle at the bottom left, a notebook left open on the desk edge. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artwork from Image 2 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and fully legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
